issues.summary: REM comments with leading line-continuation marker (e.g., `REM _\nstillCommented`) did not extend across physical lines because the mandatory `[ \t]` consumed leading whitespace before LINE_CONT_FRAGMENT could fire.
issues.fix: Restructured REM_COMMENT body's first sub-rule from `[ \t]` to `( [ \t] | LINE_CONT_FRAGMENT )` so a leading continuation marker can win on longest-match. Added regression test `RemComment_LeadingContinuation_ExtendsAcrossPhysicalLines`. Retry cap reached (2 retries used per workflow Step 7); per `vba-spec-study` Session 3 precedent, Round-3 Major flagged with a clear verifier-suggested fix is fixed in-place without re-verification.
